purpose: Declare physical domain relation, head semantics, storage ownership and exchange meaning before constructing or interpreting a SWAP-MODFLOW coupling.

DISTINCT_DOMAIN_INTERFACE.physical_state_count: at least one state in each subsystem; interface head continuity may be imposed without identifying complete subsystem states
DISTINCT_DOMAIN_INTERFACE.storage_rule: Each subsystem owns storage in its own physical control volume. No shared-volume partition identity is implied.
DISTINCT_DOMAIN_INTERFACE.mass_authority: Accepted interface exchange is loss from one control volume and gain to the other, counted exactly once.
DISTINCT_DOMAIN_INTERFACE.derivative_rule: A coupling response slope may approximate the interface response but is not storage ownership unless separately derived.

ZERO_RESISTANCE_DISJOINT_SHARED_HEAD.storage_rule: Physical storages are additive because the volumes are distinct: S_total=S_1+S_2.
ZERO_RESISTANCE_DISJOINT_SHARED_HEAD.exchange_kind: PHYSICAL_INTERNAL_TRANSFER_FOR_FINITE_RESISTANCE; limiting constraint variable as resistance tends to zero
ZERO_RESISTANCE_DISJOINT_SHARED_HEAD.equivalence_condition: As resistance tends to zero, head gap tends to zero while total storage remains the sum of the two disjoint physical storages.

COEXTENSIVE_SHARED_PHREATIC.storage_rule: Owned storage contributions must partition one physical storage response with no overlap and no gap: S_phys = sum_i S_owned_i.
COEXTENSIVE_SHARED_PHREATIC.mass_authority: The one geometric/shared physical volume change is authoritative; subsystem bookkeeping must reconcile to it.

endpoint_controls.MODFLOW_OWNS_ALL_SHARED_STORAGE: S_MODFLOW=S_phys, S_SWAP=0; SWAP coupling term excludes that shared storage.
endpoint_controls.PARTITIONED: S_MODFLOW+S_SWAP=S_phys pointwise or over the declared finite-window storage map.

COEXTENSIVE_SHARED_PHREATIC.duplicate_signature: If both components claim the same full physical storage, numerical bookkeeping can close while the one physical volume responds with doubled effective storage.

required_configuration_fields: physical_control_volume_ids owned by SWAP and MODFLOW
physical storage law for every shared/coextensive volume
MODFLOW Sy/Ss ownership mapping to physical volume ids
SWAP storage-response ownership mapping to physical volume ids
accepted physical exchange object and sign convention
iteration-response derivative provenance and whether it owns physical mass
independent residual, volume-balance and ledger acceptance gates

required_invariants.equation: sum(storage shares for one physical volume) = physical storage response
all physical storage response is assigned to exactly one declared owner partition
required_invariants.failure: missing ownership / excessive head response or underdetermination

required_invariants.equation: A head may be declared shared only for the same physical location/state meaning.
required_invariants.failure: interface head silently reinterpreted as phreatic water-table state

required_invariants.equation: storage-like units do not assign physical storage ownership
required_invariants.failure: u_A/HCOF/Jacobian interpreted as physical storage without domain derivation

rejection_examples: COEXTENSIVE_SHARED_PHREATIC with MODFLOW owning 100% of S_phys and SWAP also owning 100% of S_phys.
COEXTENSIVE_SHARED_PHREATIC with neither subsystem owning a known nonzero part of S_phys.
DISTINCT_DOMAIN_INTERFACE configured with one interface exchange added as a source to both physical ledgers with the same sign.
Current F-GC lower-interface head relabeled as shared phreatic state without a typed phreatic state machine and storage contract.
Using finite-window u_A as static MODFLOW Sy without an explicit state/window-to-storage derivation.

current_evidence_classification.F_GC45_fixture: DISTINCT_DOMAIN_INTERFACE / shared lower-interface hydraulic head; not demonstrated coextensive phreatic storage
current_evidence_classification.legacy_SWBOTB1: scientific lineage for PHREATIC_STATE boundary semantics, not currently production-typed
current_evidence_classification.DSW23: prospective coextensive shared-phreatic ownership oracle awaiting live MODFLOW qualification
current_evidence_classification.DSW24: prospective interface-to-phreatic equivalence/nonequivalence oracle awaiting live MODFLOW qualification

production_decision_boundary: No current production storage rewrite follows from this research contract.
A product configuration intended to be COEXTENSIVE_SHARED_PHREATIC must declare and validate the physical storage partition before admission.
A boundary-coupled configuration may keep physically distinct storages on both sides when their volumes are genuinely distinct.
Partial physical overlap is not covered by this v1 contract and must be rejected or separately derived.
